description: The Regional Transport Office (RTO) Ajmer is the primary authority for vehicle registration and licensing in the Ajmer district of Rajasthan. It serves as a key administrative hub for transport services in central Rajasthan, overseeing the issuance of driving licenses, permits, and fitness certificates.
address: Jaipur Road, Near Village Ghooghra, Ajmer, Rajasthan

description: RJ-02 is the Regional Transport Office for Alwar district, Rajasthan. It acts as a major hub for vehicle registration and licensing in the region, which is a significant industrial and historical center located between Delhi and Jaipur.
address: RTO Office, Vijay Mandir Road, Dholi Dhub, Alwar, Rajasthan

description: RJ-03 is the official District Transport Office (DTO) for Banswara, Rajasthan. It manages vehicle registration, permits, and licensing for the tribal-dominated Vagad region, also known as the City of a Hundred Islands.
address: Gandhi Nagar, GPO Circle, Banswara, Rajasthan

description: The RJ-04 Regional Transport Office serves the Barmer district in Rajasthan, facilitating vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permit services. It plays a vital role in regulating transport activities in Western Rajasthan, particularly supporting the local economy and border-area logistics.
address: Near Circuit House, National Highway 15 (N.H.-15), Barmer, Rajasthan

description: RJ-05 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Bharatpur district in eastern Rajasthan. It is responsible for critical services including vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road tax collection. The office plays a vital role in managing the heavy tourist and commercial traffic flow characteristic of the Bharatpur region.
address: Regional Transport Office, Keshav Nagar, Near New Myes Nagar, Bharatpur, Rajasthan
